attchmntText: Rama Steel Tubes Limited has informed the Exchange about The issuance of a Corporate Guarantee by the Company in favour of/ on behalf of M/s. RST International Trading FZE, UAE, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company.
desc: Giving guarantees/indemnity/ becoming a surety for third party
voiceSummary: Rama Steel Tubes Limited approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board also approved further investment in wholly owned subsidiary RST International Trading FZE via share acquisition and issuance of a corporate guarantee in its favor. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 19,191.08 lakhs with a profit after tax of 1,911.17 lakhs. Earnings per share stood at 0.12. The company noted that shareholders passed special resolutions on October 21, 2026, for a preferential issue and increase in authorized share capital, but stock exchange approvals are awaited. Additionally, the company filed for striking off the name of subsidiary Rama Defence Pvt Ltd, which has not commenced business. The application is pending approval by the Registrar of Companies.
